items.title: Oliver Nelson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 10, 2020
items.q: And after that I said well — and I looked at his life, because he studied at Juilliard. So I said you really want to play the instrument well.

ctx.x: Um hum. That “Wildflowers” LP that I just think has got it all.

Oh yeah, you know it’s interesting that you bring the albums up, because the first album I heard was “Afro Classics” and this is, I think I was 14, 15 years old. My stepmother gave me a flute, I went into a closet and was hyperventilating trying to get a sound out of that thing. And after that I said well — and I looked at his life, because he studied at Juilliard. So I said you really want to play the instrument well. Because once you do that then you can go and learn the language of jazz. So I started to take…
